notes: kind 'max': a metric passes when value < limit. kind 'min': passes when value >= limit. 'metrics' lists the result keys (see bench/run.ps1) checked against the budget; an empty list means nothing measures it yet and 'measured_by' names the task that will. 'coverage' says what part of the user-visible path a metric covers today.

budgets.coverage: Process start to visible themed window (bench/cold-start.ps1, warm file cache).

budgets.requirement: Open 10 MB PDF, first page sharp
budgets.coverage: Core only: PDFium open + render page 1 at 1280 px. No IPC or UI paint until T-018/T-020.

budgets.requirement: Open 1,000-page / 300 MB PDF, first page (no full parse)
budgets.coverage: Core only: PDFium open + render page 1 at 1280 px. No IPC or UI paint until T-018/T-020.
Core proxy: re-render of a whole open page at 1280 px. No tiles, IPC or paint yet.

budgets.requirement: Memory: idle with 1 small PDF (includes WebView2)
budgets.coverage: Empty window, no PDF open yet (the app cannot open files before T-018). Private working set of the app and all WebView2 processes (bench/memory.ps1).
Core probe only: peak working set of a process that opened the 300 MB file and rendered page 1. No WebView2, no tile cache yet.
budgets.measured_by: T-020 (tile cache), then bench/memory.ps1 -AppPid with the file open

budgets.coverage: Uncompressed payload (swiftpdf.exe + pdfium.dll). The installer is compressed, so this is an upper bound until bundling exists.

budgets.requirement: Incremental save, 1 annotation on 300 MB file
